Why the Daytime Sky Turns Blue (Not Purple)! — Sunlight looks white—so why does the sky paint itself giant blue every morning?
Kids science answer for "why is the sky blue for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Sunlight carries every rainbow color; shorter blue light waves bounce off tiny air molecules across the sky far more than red waves.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
